dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of the local linguistic landscape database.

database.title: Database
database.subtitle: Manage imported linguistic landscape records.
database.noMatch: No records match the current filters.
database.empty: No records yet. Click “{{button}}” above to upload a package exported from LLMap Mobile.

import.title: Import Dataset Package
import.introUpload: Upload a package exported by LLMap Mobile ({{pattern}}).
import.introDetail: Records go into the local database; photos are copied into backend storage. Duplicate SignIDs are skipped, never overwritten.
import.notZip: “{{name}}” is not a .zip file. Please select a llmap_dataset_*.zip.
import.selectFirst: Please select a Dataset Package (.zip) first.
import.keepOriginal: Keep the original package in archives/ (uses extra disk space)
import.duplicateBody: An identical package was imported on {{date}} as “{{name}}”. Importing again would add no new records.

map.title: Map
map.subtitle: Spatial distribution of collected records.
map.gpsNote: Only records with latitude and longitude are shown on the map.
map.noMatch: No mapped records match the current filters.
map.noGps: No records with GPS yet. Import a Dataset Package that contains coordinates.

review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Work through records that still need human confirmation (quick captures, standard submissions, AI drafts).
review.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and switch record?
review.allReviewed: All selected records have been reviewed.
review.selectPrompt: Select a record from the queue to start reviewing.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Export filtered database records for analysis and archiving.
export.csvNote: CSV export uses the current database records and selected filters. System fields such as CaptureID, SignID, EntryMode, DataStatus, SchemaVersion, and AppVersion are included. Photos are not included in CSV export — use Dataset Package export in a future version when images are required.
export.formatCsvDesc: All 36 schema columns, UTF-8 with BOM (Excel compatible). Photos are not included.
export.formatDatasetDesc: Full re-export as llmap_dataset zip with photos, manifest and schema.
export.formatGeojsonDesc: Records with GPS as a FeatureCollection for GIS tools.
export.formatPhotosDesc: Crop and source photos of the selected records.

ai.title: AI Processing
ai.subtitle: Batch AI assistance for large collections.
ai.note: AI suggestions are drafts — they never overwrite human-reviewed fields and must be reviewed before becoming research data.
ai.safety1: No AI task will run until an AI backend is configured.
ai.safety2: No API key should be committed to the repository (keys will be read from backend environment variables).
ai.safety3: AI suggestions will be stored separately from human-confirmed fields
ai.safety4: AI results enter the Review queue as "ai_drafted"; humans confirm them there.

lang.title: Language identification
lang.desc: Detect the languages appearing on each sign photo.

ocr.title: OCR / text extraction
ocr.desc: Extract visible text from crop photos.

fields.title: Field suggestion
fields.desc: Draft research fields (script, carrier, agent…) from the photo.

translate.title: Translation
translate.desc: Translate extracted text for cross-language analysis.

dup.title: Duplicate detection
dup.desc: Find likely duplicate captures of the same sign.

privacy.title: Privacy risk detection
privacy.desc: Flag faces, plates, or personal data before sharing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Console configuration. Kept minimal — no accounts, no permissions.
settings.languageDesc: The display language switches immediately and is saved on this device.
settings.languageNote: Data itself is never translated — field keys, CSV headers, API values and internal status values stay unchanged.
settings.backendHelpPrefix: To change it in web/dev mode, set
settings.backendHelpSuffix: and restart npm run dev. The desktop app injects the URL automatically at startup.

storage.title: Storage
storage.cleanupConfirm: This will delete {{size}} of legacy import leftovers. Official photos, the database and archives are never touched. Proceed?
storage.cleanupBlocked: Cleanup aborted: {{n}} photos are missing from the official store. Restore them via “Only restore missing photos” first.
